values.note: Plus taxes: back-in and pull-through sites (41-75) $60 a night; waterfront sites 25-40 $65, 1-24 $75. Weekly $275-345, monthly $500-900 plus a $100 electric deposit. 2% charge on credit cards; boats and trailers $10 a day.

fees.source: https://srbrvpark.com/about-us/ (Rates: 'Sites 1 through 24 – site type – waterfront – pricing 75.00 nightly'; 'Sites 25 through 40 ... 65.00 nightly'; 'Sites 51 through 59 – site type – back in – pricing 60.00 nightly'), page undated (footer Copyright © 2026), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://srbrvpark.com/faq/ ('Yes, all of our sites are full hook and 30/50 amps'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: The home page says 77 shaded waterfront lots; the rate table numbers sites 1-75 (1-40 waterfront, 41-75 pull-through or back-in) and the FAQ describes 50 waterfront lots plus several interior lots. All sites have a cement slab.

sites.source: https://srbrvpark.com/ ('We feature 77 majestically shaded waterfront lots ... We offer back-in and pull through sites') + https://srbrvpark.com/about-us/ + https://srbrvpark.com/faq/, read 2026-10-21

values.note: Bath house, 24-hour laundry, clubhouse with full kitchen; free Wi-Fi; floating boat docks for a small fee; canal to the Suwannee River, boat ramp about 1/4 mile away.

facilities.source: https://srbrvpark.com/faq/ ('We now have Wifi!!! This upgraded service is free ... We have a bath house, 24-hour laundry, and a clubhouse'), read 2026-10-21

discounts.source: https://srbrvpark.com/faq/ ('Do you offer any discounts? Yes we do but only to active military and first responders'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Book online through the park's Book Online page (a Bookmysites widget) or call 352-542-7680. Daily and weekly stays are paid in full when reserved; no-shows are not refunded. Management may inspect and refuse RVs over 15 years old. Check-in 2 pm, check-out 11 am.
